steps.title: Describe your project
steps.body: Tell Lovart what you need in plain language with specific style, content, and format requirements. The more context you provide, the better the output matches your vision.

steps.title: Review AI compositions
steps.body: Lovart generates multiple design options. Evaluate each on visual hierarchy, information clarity, and professional impact. Pick the strongest candidate.

steps.title: Refine with Touch Edit

steps.title: Export for your use case
steps.body: Print-ready PDF with bleed and CMYK, or digital-optimized formats. Lovart auto-configures all technical settings based on your specified output requirements.
